lines.beaver: 요즘 밥은 잘 먹고 있어? 식습관은 어때?
lines.beaver_en: Are you eating well these days? How are your eating habits?
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum babeun jal meokgo isseo? sikseupgwaneun eottae?
lines.learner: 그럭저럭 먹지, 뭐. 근데 식욕이 너무 좋아.
lines.en: I eat okay, I guess. But my appetite is way too good.
lines.roman: geureokjeoreok meokji, mwo. geunde sigyogi neomu joa.

lines.beaver: 식욕이 좋은 건 괜찮아. 고기를 많이 먹어?
lines.beaver_en: A good appetite is fine. Do you eat a lot of meat?
lines.beaver_roman: sigyogi joeun geon gwaenchana. gogireul mani meogeo?
lines.learner: 응, 육식을 많이 해. 매일 고기를 먹지, 뭐.
lines.en: Yeah, I eat a lot of meat. I just have it every day.
lines.roman: eung, yuksigeul mani hae. maeil gogireul meokji, mwo.

lines.beaver: 고기는 단백질이 많지만 채소도 먹어야 해.
lines.beaver_en: Meat has lots of protein, but you need vegetables too.
lines.beaver_roman: gogineun danbaekjiri manchiman chaesodo meogeoya hae.
lines.learner: 문제는 채소를 거의 안 먹는다는 거야.
lines.en: The thing is, I hardly eat any vegetables.
lines.roman: munjeneun chaesoreul geoui an meongneundaneun geoya.

lines.beaver_en: Then you might be short on nutrients.
lines.en: My doctor said so too. She said I lack nutrients.

lines.beaver: 열량도 봐야 해. 하루에 얼마나 먹어?
lines.beaver_en: You should check calories too. How much do you eat a day?
lines.beaver_roman: yeollyangdo bwaya hae. harue eolmana meogeo?
lines.learner: 잘 모르겠어. 열량 계산을 자꾸 깜박해.
lines.en: I'm not sure. I keep forgetting to count calories.
lines.roman: jal moreugesseo. yeollyang gyesaneul jakku kkambakae.

lines.beaver_en: Do you tend to eat a lot at night?
lines.learner: 응, 스트레스를 받으면 밤에 폭식을 해.
lines.en: Yeah, when I'm stressed, I binge at night.
lines.roman: eung, seuteureseureul badeumyeon bame poksigeul hae.

lines.beaver: 폭식은 비만의 원인이 될 수 있어.
lines.beaver_roman: poksigeun bimanui wonini doel su isseo.
lines.learner: 알아. 요즘 살이 쪄서 비만이 걱정돼.
lines.en: I know. I've gained weight lately, so I worry about obesity.
lines.roman: ara. yojeum sari jjeoseo bimani geokjeongdwae.

lines.beaver: 먼저 저녁 섭취량을 조금 줄여 보자.
lines.beaver_en: First, let's cut down your dinner intake a little.
lines.beaver_roman: meonjeo jeonyeok seopchwiryangeul jogeum juryeo boja.
lines.learner: 좋아. 야식 섭취를 줄이는 게 먼저지, 뭐.
lines.en: Okay. Cutting late-night snacks comes first, I guess.
lines.roman: joa. yasik seopchwireul jurineun ge meonjeoji, mwo.

lines.beaver: 고기 대신 두부로 단백질을 먹어 봐.
lines.beaver_en: Try getting protein from tofu instead of meat.
lines.beaver_roman: gogi daesin duburo danbaekjireul meogeo bwa.
lines.en: Tofu sounds good. My friends said it's tasty too.

lines.beaver: 좋아! 다음 주에 식습관 얘기 또 하자.
lines.beaver_en: Great! Let's talk about your eating habits again next week.
lines.beaver_roman: joa! daeum jue sikseupgwan yaegi tto haja.
lines.learner: 고마워. 이번엔 꼭 지켜 볼게. 응원해 줘!
lines.en: Thanks. I'll really stick to it this time. Cheer me on!
lines.roman: gomawo. ibeonen kkok jikyeo bolge. eungwonhae jwo!
